DIVINER-CRYSTAL_BALL.title: Crystal Ball
DIVINER-CRYSTAL_BALL.description: At the start of combat, add a Fortune or Misfortune to your hand. Right-click to open or close the Destiny ledger.
DIVINER-CRYSTAL_BALL.flavor: A cloudy lens full of futures that almost happened.
DIVINER-CLOUDED_LENS.title: Clouded Lens
DIVINER-CLOUDED_LENS.description: The first time you Divinate each combat, draw 2 cards.
DIVINER-CLOUDED_LENS.flavor: The fog clears just enough to see the next mistake.
DIVINER-BRASS_DOWSING_ROD.title: Brass Dowsing Rod
DIVINER-BRASS_DOWSING_ROD.description: Whenever your Destiny changes, gain 7 Block.
DIVINER-BRASS_DOWSING_ROD.flavor: It trembles at the exact frequency of bad decisions.
DIVINER-BLOOD_TABLET.title: Blood Tablet
DIVINER-BLOOD_TABLET.flavor: The oldest prophecies are written in the body.
DIVINER-PIEDRA_DEL_SOL.title: Piedra del Sol
DIVINER-PIEDRA_DEL_SOL.description: Foretell effects that deal damage or gain Block do 2 more.
DIVINER-PIEDRA_DEL_SOL.flavor: A small sun caught in patient stone.
DIVINER-KNOCKED_COMPASS.title: Knocked Compass
DIVINER-KNOCKED_COMPASS.description: At the start of combat, if Bad Omen, apply 2 Weak to all enemies.
DIVINER-KNOCKED_COMPASS.flavor: It points south. Then south again.
DIVINER-MARKED_DECK.title: Marked Deck
DIVINER-MARKED_DECK.description: Card rewards have 1 additional option while Good Omen.
DIVINER-MARKED_DECK.flavor: Every back has a little tell.
DIVINER-PROPHETS_QUILL.title: Prophet's Quill
DIVINER-PROPHETS_QUILL.description: The first time you Divinate each combat, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
DIVINER-SEALED_ENVELOPE.title: Sealed Envelope
DIVINER-SEALED_ENVELOPE.description: On pickup, Divinate 3 times and gain 1 Destiny.
DIVINER-SEALED_ENVELOPE.flavor: Only open after it already mattered.
DIVINER-HOURGLASS_OF_MERCY.title: Hourglass of Mercy
DIVINER-HOURGLASS_OF_MERCY.description: Doomed starts with 5 Countdown of Destiny instead of 3. The first Escape from Destiny each combat costs 0.
DIVINER-HOURGLASS_OF_MERCY.flavor: A few grains have been taught pity.
DIVINER-ORACLE_BONE.title: Oracle Bone
DIVINER-FIXED_STAR_MAP.title: Fixed Star Map
DIVINER-FIXED_STAR_MAP.flavor: A chart of stars that refuse to drift.
DIVINER-LAST_PROPHECY.title: Last Prophecy
DIVINER-LAST_PROPHECY.description: Once per combat, if you would die with at least 8 recorded Divinations, delete up to 9 records and heal to 1 HP.
DIVINER-LAST_PROPHECY.flavor: The final sentence is always conditional.
DIVINER-VELVET_POUCH.title: Velvet Pouch
DIVINER-VELVET_POUCH.description: Gain 1 Potion slot. Potions are 40% cheaper and potion drop rate is increased by 40%; these effects are doubled in Good Omen.
DIVINER-VELVET_POUCH.flavor: Soft enough to keep the future from rattling.
DIVINER-FATED_CONTRACT.title: Fated Contract
DIVINER-FATED_CONTRACT.description: On pickup and at the start of each act, set Destiny to 5. Destiny of 4 or more no longer improves reward rarity.
DIVINER-FATED_CONTRACT.flavor: The future signs first, then asks.
DIVINER-DESTINED_CRYSTAL_BALL.title: Destined Crystal Ball
DIVINER-DESTINED_CRYSTAL_BALL.descriptio: Your divinations are recorded here. At the start of combat, add a Fortune+ and a Misfortune+ to your hand. They cost 0 this turn.
DIVINER-DESTINED_CRYSTAL_BALL.flavor: A clear lens: one blessing, one ruin, both already chosen.
